title: Q2 circuit certificate, characterization v1
description: The canonical bundle a Q2 certificate commits to. The on-chain record stores sha256 of this bundle (with the `certificate` block removed) as artifact_hash, so the certificate proves possession of the circuit's structure and the measured conformance and cost of that circuit, without disclosing the design. Every smart-contract registration of a circuit references a bundle conforming to this schema.

interface.description: The port/behaviour contract a parent may rely on. Public.

design_hash.description: sha256 of the design bundle (RTL/GDS). Commitment only; the design stays private.

lineage.description: artifact_hash of each DIRECT child certificate this circuit is composed from.

proof_of_record.description: The mathematical proof that this structure is what it claims to be.

level.description: 1 exhaustive (SPICE truth table); 2 SAT equivalence; 3 techmap onto proven cells; 4 composition of proven parts.

sha256.description: Hash of the proof artifact of record.

soundness.description: Reference to the composition-soundness theorem under which level 4 is valid, when applicable.

conformance.description: The external standard the circuit meets, and the exact parameters within which it meets it. This is 'accomplishes IEEE 754 within a set of parameters'.

scope.description: The parameter set the claim holds within: rounding modes, subnormal handling, exception flags, operand ranges. State every limitation.

method.description: How conformance was established. Simulation with vectors is evidence, never a stand-alone proof.

result.description: exact = bit-identical to the reference; bounded = within max_ulp.

coverage.description: e.g. '2^32 exhaustive unary', '2^64 via 3-stage decomposition + Lean glue', 'N directed+random vectors'.

characterization.description: The circuit-intrinsic cost axes, every figure pinned to a stated corner, temperature and input activity. A circuit is a point on this surface; different circuits for the same interface specialize on different axes (area, energy, time), which is expected, not a defect.

latency_ns.description: Combinational delay or cycles x period for the operation.

fmax_mhz.description: From static timing on the critical path.

energy.description: Energy is not a scalar: it depends on the input distribution and the duty cycle. Every figure names its activity and idle fraction.

activity.description: The stated input distribution / switching-activity assumption the dynamic figure is measured at, e.g. 'uniform-random operands', 'alpha=0.2'.

idle_fraction.description: Duty cycle used to fold leakage into energy_fj_per_op.

energy_fj_per_op.description: Total per operation at the stated activity and idle fraction.

power_density_w_mm2.description: Dissipation rate per area. A workload can be power-limited while energy-abundant.

thermal_margin.description: Headroom to the process's power-density / junction-temperature ceiling.

mantissa_bits.description: Bits of significand preserved, when the circuit trades precision for cost.

entropy.description: The information-theoretic normalizer. Lets every cost axis be priced per useful bit and against the Landauer floor, and lets a mission's workload (bits to process) be compared to a process's capability.

operand_distribution.description: The input distribution the entropy figures are relative to; entropy is not an intrinsic circuit property.

bits_discarded_per_op.description: H(input|output): the information the operation necessarily destroys under the stated distribution. For IEEE 754 the alignment shift and rounding dominate this.

thermodynamic_efficiency.description: landauer_floor / energy. Distance to the physical floor; two circuits equal on area and time can differ here, and that distance is the licensable improvement.

status.description: Measurement state per axis, so a certificate is honest about what is measured versus pending.

payload.description: Process- and mission-applied, not circuit-intrinsic: derived from the fabrication stack and package when the circuit is placed in a system. Optional at registration.

reliability.description: Mission-applied: error rate and wear over sustained operation, set by the environment (temperature, radiation) and lifetime. Optional at registration.

measurement_provenance.description: What produced the numbers, so any skeptic can reproduce them. Content-addresses the apparatus, not only the artifact.

certificate.description: The on-chain commitment. artifact_hash is sha256 of this whole bundle with the `certificate` block removed (see tools/cert_hash.py). Filled in when the circuit is registered.
